name: congen
description: Content generation desktop app. Three independent layers: electron (window + native OS features), ui (React + Tailwind), api (Express, owns all Replicate and blob logic).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,UI,ELECTRON -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev -w congen-api" "npm run dev -w congen-ui" "npm run dev:wait -w congen-electron"
scripts.build: npm run build -w congen-api && npm run build:bundle -w congen-api && npm run build -w congen-ui && npm run package -w congen-electron
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w congen-ui && npm run lint -w congen-electron && npm run lint -w congen-api
